content:
Jordan: Following up from the all-hands Q&A  here's a compact owner-run checklist for API runtime v2, Console features, and Optimize so teams know who to ping.

Leah: API runtime v2 rollout summary: internal canary starts next Tue, partner pilots 3w after, GA ~6w after partner pilots. We'll provide an explicit opt-in (header or query param) and no forced migrations for pinned models. Example usage: `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` or `?api_version=v2`.

Priya: A few ops questions from customers: metric coverage and SLA signals. What should CS and SRE watch during canaries?

Evan: Telemetry guidance: watch token-per-request drift, p50/p95 generation latency, and KV/cache hit ratios. Also add a quality check: top-100 prompt evals must not degrade by more than 0.5% exact-match (we'll provide eval harness). We'll publish a short runbook for interpreting these signals.

Sofia: Console timeline and feature breakdown: beta (internal + pilot partners) in mid-May, public opt-in beta early June, GA end of Q2. Beta includes per-route token cost, latency heatmaps, and a simple canary manager (start/pause/rollback). We'll pilot a tighter UX for route-level quick-rollbacks.

Leah: Optimize rollout: batching/caching advisor = internal alpha in 2 sprints, public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender with per-model quality/cost deltas targeted for Q3. Optimize will publish recommended knob sets and estimated cost delta before applying.

Jordan: SDK impact: small change to streaming frames for incremental function args. We'll add a new event name `partial_function_args` to `client.stream()` callbacks in Python/JS. Deprecation window for the old frame after GA is 90 days; enterprise customers can request up to 6 months of extended compatibility.

TelemetryBot: alert: "canary-deploy started: runtime/v2 -> alpha-cluster at 2034567922"

Priya: For Dedicated/Private customers: control-plane first, then rolling node updates. Private deployments will get an upgrade package + a checklist. We'll offer scheduled windows and a preview mode for customers who want to test traffic routing before flip.

Evan: On metrics dashboards: Console will surface the following for canaries by default: token cost delta vs baseline, p50/p90/p99 latencies, error rates, and a quality-regression signal tied to the sample eval set. Product & Telemetry: please confirm exact chart definitions.

Sofia: Integration note: Optimize suggestions will be shown in Console as one-click experiments during public alpha (late-May/early-June). The experiment UI will show expected cost savings and an estimated quality delta.

Jordan: Action items: 1) @Leah publish the rollout + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Evan publish the telemetry runbook and sample eval harness. 3) @Sofia post the Console beta invite criteria and pilot sign-up. 4) @Priya prepare Dedicated/Private customer maintenance templates and preview upgrade flow docs.

Leah: I'll draft the migration checklist and include exact opt-in examples and fallback behavior.

Evan: I'll share the telemetry runbook and the eval harness repo link once ready.

Sofia: Will post the pilot signup doc and invite flow to #product later today.

Priya: I'll coordinate notice templates with CS & Sales and attach the preview-mode instructions.

Jordan: If anyone from the panel still has an unanswered question, paste it here and we'll route it. Thanks everyone :rocket:
